purpose: Requirements for the reviewer agent in the review mechanism: how it reads targets, determines target type, which documents it uses per type, and what findings and error values it returns.
summary: Reviewer reads targets and applies review perspectives to return findings
Defines target type, review perspective, and perspective document terms
Reviewer definition contents specific to the reviewer (FNC-301)
Reading targets by targets shape: paths, base_branch, diff, including deletions and renames (FNC-306)
Target type determination among code, requirement, design, plan, uxui using config and file content (FNC-307)
Per-target-type documents: common set plus type-specific criteria, norms, project rules and cross-check targets (FNC-308)
Findings output: none means zero findings; reviewers are interchangeable (FNC-309)
Secret detection is out of scope; shared contract is delegated to REQ-029
tasks: Reviewing or modifying the reviewer agent definition
Changing review criteria documents or norm mapping per target type
Reviewing requirement documents on the review mechanism
Changing resolve_doc_structure script for type resolution
title: REQ-027 reviewer の入力・作業・出力の契約 要件定義書
